comparison.objective: Cast a concrete cylinder in two layers, rod each layer 25 times, and strike the surface flat; candidate breaks and recovers four HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated depth-distributed rodding and surface finishing versus coaxial mandrel placement, controlled hammer impact, and millimetre-scale fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Title specifies two layers, 25 rods per layer, and a flat struck-off top; candidate requires four notch fractures, containment, retained inserts, and no damage.
comparison.reason: The record lacks detailed scoring tolerances and failure rules, but its stated bulk-material compaction outcome is clearly different from discrete insert-tang fracture.
